_comment: One option is picked at random from each category and injected into redesign/prompt.md. Add, remove, or ban freely. Picks are recorded in designs/<date>/design.json. The last 'avoidRepeatWithin' picks per category are excluded so consecutive weeks differ.

style: Swiss International Typographic Style: strict grid, asymmetric layout, flush-left type
Neo-brutalism: thick black borders, hard offset shadows, flat saturated fills
Raw web brutalism: default-browser energy, exposed structure, monospace, deliberate roughness
Editorial magazine: dramatic serif display type, pull quotes, column layouts
Retro terminal / CRT: phosphor glow, scanlines, command-line metaphors
Y2K chrome: glossy gradients, bubbly shapes, iridescent highlights
Bauhaus: primary shapes, geometric composition, bold blocks of color
Japanese minimalism: generous whitespace, quiet hierarchy, hairline rules
Memphis design: playful squiggles, confetti patterns, clashing pastel geometry
Glassmorphism: frosted translucent panels over soft blurred color fields
Blueprint / technical drawing: grid paper, dimension lines, annotation callouts
Art Deco: symmetry, gold linework, stepped geometric ornament
Risograph print: grainy textures, misregistered two-ink overprints
Data-dense dashboard: panels, sparklines built from real numbers, compact UI chrome
Museum exhibition: placards, generous margins, gallery-wall pacing
Hand-drawn sketchbook: wobbly SVG strokes, marker highlights, paper texture
Retro 8-bit / pixel art: chunky pixels, sprite-like UI, limited palette
Newspaper broadsheet: mastheads, dense columns, rules, halftone imagery
Kinetic typography: type as the primary visual, scale contrast, motion-driven
Claymorphism: soft 3D inflated shapes, pastel shading, rounded everything
Cyberpunk HUD: neon on black, angular frames, targeting reticles
Scandinavian: muted naturals, soft geometry, calm functional layout
Operating-system desktop: windows, icons, a dock, draggable panels
Trading card / collectible: each section is a card with stats and foil effects
Topographic / cartographic: contour lines, map legends, coordinates as decoration
palette: Monochrome black and white with a single signal-red accent
Hot pink, electric blue and black
Solarized-inspired: base03 backgrounds with yellow, cyan and magenta accents
Pastel lavender, mint and butter yellow
Warm off-white paper with oxblood and charcoal
Grayscale only, expressed through texture and weight
Sunset gradient: coral, magenta and indigo
Ocean: teal, seafoam and deep slate
Primary triad: red, yellow, blue on white
Riso inks: fluorescent pink and federal blue on newsprint
typography: Grotesk sans for everything, extreme size contrast
High-contrast didone serif headlines with a neutral sans body
Geometric sans display with a humanist serif body
Condensed ultra-bold display with a light, wide body
Slab serif headlines with a monospace body
Variable font with weight animated on scroll or hover
Blackletter or decorative display used sparingly with a clean sans body
Handwritten display with a typewriter body
layout: Single long vertical scroll with full-bleed sections
Horizontal scrolling gallery on desktop, vertical on mobile
Split screen: fixed left column with identity, scrolling right column
Tabbed or card-stack interface instead of scrolling
Timeline-first: experience on a vertical timeline spine
Dashboard of panels in a fixed viewport grid on desktop
Zine: each section is a distinct 'page' with its own composition
motion: Restrained: subtle fades and short translations only
Cinematic: scroll-driven reveals with parallax depth
Typewriter: text appears progressively as it enters the viewport (only real data text)
Hover-centric: rich hover and focus states, static otherwise
Almost none: the design is about stillness
wildcard: The headshot must be a central visual motif
Use the testimonials as a dominant visual element
Include a light and dark mode toggle
Experience stats are displayed as large numerals
Use a visible grid overlay as decoration
The project phone videos are the hero
Lean heavily on SVG illustration made of shapes (no text inside)
Every section has a different background treatment
